message.content: An editorial illustration for a magazine cover features a figure riding a motorcycle. The figure has the body of a person wearing a black leather jacket and black pants, but their head is a skull engulfed in yellow and orange flames. The figure’s right hand is raised, holding the hilt of a long, thin, silver metallic blade that extends towards the top right corner. Their left hand rests on the handlebar of a dark grey and blue scooter-style motorcycle, which is shown in profile facing left. The motorcycle has two black wheels, a visible engine area, and a red taillight. The entire scene is set against a solid dark blue background with a vertical red stripe on the far left and a horizontal red stripe at the bottom. White text at the top reads "PELAPOR TEMPO: SAYA BUKAN ORANG BENAR / LULUNG DAN ANGGARAN SILUMAN". The large white word "TEMPO" is centered below. Smaller white text on the left reads "INVESTIGASI LAPORAN DARI KAMPUNG BEGAL". A barcode and price information are at the bottom left.
